canonical_name: Cybersecurity Not Included in Human Resources Practices
description: Cybersecurity is not included in human resources practices.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Enterprise governance and leadership functions Strategic planning and risk management teams Organizations subject to regulatory compliance requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify organizations where cybersecurity is not integrated into hiring processes, job descriptions lack cybersecurity responsibilities, performance reviews do not include security metrics, onboarding/offboarding procedures lack security components, or security awareness training is not mandatory for all personnel.
